answer: Route provenance: an auditor probes each identity's endpoint from three looking glasses each epoch, logging origin AS, BGP path and round-trip vector, so the route table becomes a mirror of every claim. Two identities sharing an origin AS and a /24, or correlating above 0.98 in latency, are voided and their $500 bond slashed. A fake needs its own transit prefix: $140 monthly plus a $25 host, so 5,000 fakes cost $700,000 monthly. An honest agent rents one prefix once; a farm pays per fake. A proxy is a ripple on borrowed water; a routed prefix is a quill dipped in its own ink.
